Hey everyone! The results are in, check them out below!

Best Solo Mode
#1: Forest Shuffle Solo Mode by A. Lalala
#2: Kutna Hora: The City of Silver Solo Mode by Adam Prentis
#3: Pixies Solo Mode by Michiel de Wit
#4: Mahjong Solo Mode by John Burton
#5: Sea Salt and Paper Solo Mode by Jacob Landrum
#6: Carcassonne Solo Mode by Anke L
#7: Sewer Pirats Solo Mode by Angelcollector
#8: Herbaceous Solo Mode by C.A. LaRue
#9: Ahoy Solo Mode by Ryan Moylan
#10: MLEM: Space Agency Solo Mode by Duc Vu


Best Rulebook
#1: Forest Shuffle Solo Mode by A. Lalala
#2: Pixies Solo Mode by Michiel de Wit
#3: Kutna Hora: The City of Silver Solo Mode by Adam Prentis
#4: Mahjong Solo Mode by John Burton
#5: Sea Salt and Paper Solo Mode by Jacob Landrum
#6: Coffee Rush Solo Mode by Rio Music Show
#7: Carcassonne Solo Mode by Anke L
#8: Ahoy Solo Mode by Ryan Moylan
#9: Sewer Pirats Solo Mode by Angelcollector
#10: Herbaceous Solo Mode by C.A. LaRue


Best AI System
#1: Mahjong Solo Mode by John Burton
#2: Forest Shuffle Solo Mode by A. Lalala
#3: Carcassonne Solo Mode by Anke L
#4: Kutna Hora: The City of Silver Solo Mode by Adam Prentis
#5: Sewer Pirats Solo Mode by Angelcollector
#6: Pixies Solo Mode by Michiel de Wit
#7: Sea Salt and Paper Solo Mode by Jacob Landrum
#8: Ahoy Solo Mode by Ryan Moylan
#9: Artifacts, Inc Solo Mod by Ted Heidersdorf
#10: Coffee Rush Solo Mode by Rio Music Show


Best Official Solo Mode Replacement
#1: Carcassonne Solo Mode by Anke L
#2: Herbaceous Solo Mode by C.A. LaRue
#3: Harmonies Solo Mode by Jonas Dahmen


Best Light Game Solo Mode
#1: Pixies Solo Mode by Michiel de Wit
#2: Sea Salt and Paper Solo Mode by Jacob Landrum
#3: Carcassonne Solo Mode by Anke L
#4: Herbaceous Solo Mode by C.A. LaRue
#5: Coffee Rush Solo Mode by Rio Music Show


Best Medium Complexity Game Solo Mode
#1: Forest Shuffle Solo Mode by A. Lalala
#2: Mahjong Solo Mode by John Burton
#3: Sewer Pirats Solo Mode by Angelcollector
#4: Ahoy Solo Mode by Ryan Moylan
#5: MLEM: Space Agency Solo Mode by Duc Vu


Best Complex Game Solo Mode
There were not enough entries in this category.


Best First Time Solo Mode Designer
There were not enough entries in this category.


Best Name
#1: Autopirate / Automateys (Ahoy)
#2: Tritone (Harmonies)
#3: Captain Blackwhisker (Sewer Pirats)
#4: My Octobot Teacher (Kelp)
#5: Sea Salt and Solo (Sea Salt & Paper)


Most Valuable Playtester
#1: John Barklam
#2: Tomasz Miernowski
#3: Larry Buckel

Congratulations to the winners and runner ups!

Also, congratulations to everyone who entered the contest with their solo mode as well, and special thanks to everyone who supported the contest and the designers by giving feedback or voting!
